diagnosis.pending_order: Expired priority reduce-only virtual order; administrative queue cancellation is required before recording an incomplete disposition.

correction.rule: Choose an admissible full-close instruction before simulation if the requested reduction would leave a sub-minimum adjustment. Record selected order size separately from actual fill size. Actual partial fill is determined by visible depth and is never altered afterward.
correction.partial_fill: Preserve the resulting position, including a sub-minimum residual; diagnose an unresolved priority exit on expiry. Never fabricate a close.

prospective_experiment.question: Does pre-execution selection of an admissible full-close instruction make selected order size, actual partial fill and resulting residual mechanically interpretable without post-fill rewriting?
